title: Price with tax
statementMd:
Show each product name and its price with 20% tax added, rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `name`, `price_with_tax`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, ROUND(price * 1.2, 2) AS price_with_tax FROM products;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
